guest: A few pointers would be great, but we'd rather wander than follow a timed route.
reply: A few pointers, with plenty of room to wander. After a day out, what helps you each feel comfortable and unwind back at the hotel?

discovery.focus: Comfort and unwinding at the hotel

threads.detail: Marking five years since their civil partnership; Monday dinner booked elsewhere, Tuesday evening open.
Neither wants decorations, notes or anniversary surprises.
Welcome a relaxed bistro recommendation, neither formal nor drawn-out. Gabriel loves cheese; Theo tends to avoid heavy cream sauces.
Tuesday afternoon meeting; expects to be free by 6:30. Other days are shared leisure time.

Gabriel loves architecture and is visiting Paris for the first time. Theo browses secondhand poetry books and has visited for work. Enjoy long bistro lunches; welcome a few pointers but prefer wandering to a timed route.
